scripts.build:copy-prompts: sh -c 'mkdir -p dist/extensions/subagents/prompts dist/extensions/primary-agent/prompts dist/extensions/primary-agent/routing/prompts && cp src/extensions/subagents/prompts/*.md dist/extensions/subagents/prompts/ && find src/extensions/primary-agent/prompts -maxdepth 1 -name "*.md" -exec cp {} dist/extensions/primary-agent/prompts/ \; && find src/extensions/primary-agent/routing/prompts -maxdepth 1 -name "*.md" -exec cp {} dist/extensions/primary-agent/routing/prompts/ \;'
scripts.build: npm run validate:subagent-prompts && npm run validate:primary-agent-prompts && npm run build:tsc && npm run build:copy-prompts
